title: Impeshyi munsi y'umucanga
intro: Mu nkuru za Korowani, umuntu w’umwihangane ukomeye yahuye n’ikigeragezo cyashenye imitima ikomeye cyane. Byose byarambuwe - ubutunzi, umuryango, n’ubuzima bwiza. Nyamara kuva mu bwihebe bukomeye, isengesho ryicishije bugufi ryasubijwe mu buryo butunguranye cyane. Ese ushobora kumenya uyu muntu inkuru ye yo kugarurwa ihora igaruka mu bihe bitandukanye?
clues: Nageragejwe n'ikigeragezo gikomeye cyane ku buryo kizibukwa mu bihe byose.
Natakaje ibintu byose by'ingenzi - ubutunzi bwanjye, abana banjye, n'ubuzima bwanjye.
Umubiri wanjye wari wuzuye ibisebe bibabaza, kandi bose barandekaga.
Mu gihe nari mfite agahinda, nahamagaye Allah, mubwira ko Satani yankozeho ingorane n'imibabaro.
Allah yaransubije antegeka gukubita ubutaka n'ikirenge cyanjye.
Aho hantu nyine, haturutse isoko ikonje, maze Imana igarura umuryango wanjye kandi iwukuba kabiri nk'imbabazi.

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Indwara zikomeye no gutakaza umuryango n'ubutunzi
Ubuhunzi buturutse mu mujyi wa Makka
trial.answer: Indwara zikomeye no gutakaza umuryango n'ubutunzi

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Umuryango n'ubutunzi byasubijwe kandi bikuba kabiri
Uburyo bwo kunyura mu mazi yagabanijwemo ibice butekanye
Ivuka ry'umuhungu mu buryo butangaje mu zabukuru
outcome.answer: Umuryango n'ubutunzi byasubijwe kandi bikuba kabiri

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
